profile.headline: Frontend Engineer | React, Angular & TypeScript | Enterprise Application Modernization | Shared UI Architecture | Growing Full-Stack Expertise
profile.summary:
I am a Frontend Engineer with 7+ years of experience building and modernizing enterprise web applications across automotive, banking, manufacturing, and technology. My strongest work sits at the intersection of frontend architecture, reusable UI systems, and complex product workflows.

At DLRdmv, I work on the Global UI Team supporting DLR50, DLROne, and DLRCommander. I build standalone Angular components and shared services used across multiple teams, contribute to a large Angular 15-to-21 modernization effort, and deliver individual features such as an audit logging experience that converts complex backend data into clear, filterable history for dealership and agency users.
I joined DLRdmv during a particularly demanding migration period and became productive quickly through regression fixes, end-to-end testing, production bug resolution, and a critical hotfix during my first month. I also present completed functionality to business stakeholders, explain technical solutions in business terms, and incorporate feedback into future iterations.

My core expertise includes JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular, React, RxJS, reusable component architecture, responsive design, accessibility, REST API integration, and frontend performance. I am continuing to broaden my full-stack capabilities through C#, ASP.NET, Node.js, SQL, containerization, and cloud-native development.

Long term, I want to be the engineer who can contribute wherever a team needs help - deep on the frontend, capable across the backend and delivery pipeline, and trusted to mentor others and improve the systems around me.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
• Build shared Angular UI infrastructure on the Global UI Team for DLR50, DLROne, and DLRCommander, supporting dealership sales, title, registration, lien, document, and transaction workflows.

• Contributed to the Angular 15-to-21 migration by converting NgModules to standalone architecture, adopting Signals and Reactive Forms, upgrading PrimeNG, resolving breaking changes, and validating end-to-end workflows.

• Designed an audit logging experience that transforms complex JSON into readable change history with filtering, scalable table presentation, drill-down details, and CSV export.

• Present newly delivered features to business stakeholders, translate technical decisions into product value, and use feedback to refine future enhancements.

positions.title: Front-End software engineer
positions.description:
• Led development of enterprise ESG analytics dashboards using Angular and modern component-based frontend architecture.
• Designed modular, reusable UI components using TypeScript, HTML5, and SCSS to accelerate feature delivery.
• Integrated multiple REST APIs to power real-time analytics dashboards and dynamic data visualizations.
• Applied React-inspired component design patterns and state management concepts to improve maintainability and scalability.
• Collaborated with backend engineers on C# services supporting high-volume enterprise data workflows.
• Improved performance of data-heavy UI views through lazy loading, optimized rendering strategies, and component refactoring.
positions.insights: Skills: Angular · TypeScript · .NET Framework · Next.js · Code Review · REST APIs · Responsive Web Design · C# · Redux · React.js

projects.title: Texas Restaurant Finder
projects.description:
Built a full-stack restaurant discovery application using React (Vite) and Node.js, integrating Geoapify and Unsplash APIs to aggregate and enrich location-based data.

Designed a backend data aggregation layer to normalize third-party API responses and implement TTL-based in-memory caching, reducing redundant API calls and improving performance.

Implemented dynamic map visualization using React Leaflet, synchronizing filtered restaurant data with geospatial markers and handling coordinate inconsistencies from API responses.

Developed a reusable component-based UI architecture using React Hooks and Context API, including favorites management and optimized rendering patterns.

Engineered a multi-step fallback strategy for image retrieval and rate-limit handling to ensure a resilient user experience under external API constraints.
